TUB material examples, version 2, 7 April 2022

Frederic Rudawski, Sırrı Aydınlı and Kai Broszio, TU Berlin.
Source: https://doi.org/10.14279/depositonce-11893.2
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The two CSV files are unchanged source downloads. Spectran maps their columns
to stable material identifiers in data-raw/tub_materials.R. Wood columns follow
Table 2 of the source documentation because the CSV repeats HB4/WF4 and shifts
later wood headings. Wall colours use WC1-WC12 to distinguish them from wood.
Original headings and column positions remain in the bundled provenance.

Linear interpolation from 5 nm to 1 nm takes place when a material is applied.
The dataset includes 28 reflection and 27 transmission curves. White lacquer
L1 is a TUB example but is not one of the 27 reflection rows in DIN/TS 67600.
DIN tables are not redistributed with these data.
